_comment: Source lanes for trend_monitor v2, built from the 2026-08-21 manual doom-scroll test (see project_trend_monitor.md). Each lane contributes a few candidates rather than expecting one source to carry everything - a single feed/account was proven to run out of new material within ~20-25 items in one sitting. maxAgeMinutes is checked against the ORIGIN report time (oldest <time> found in the post, not the post's own timestamp - a fresh quote-tweet on stale news should not pass).

lanes._why: Posts 'JUST IN' items roughly hourly, both good and bad news - highest volume/speed lane, tight freshness window since it posts so often
Frequent short-form crypto news, mix of protocol records/onchain stats and market moves - caught Aptos record and Cardano onchain surge in testing
Caught the freshest genuine story in testing (BounceBit L1 shutdown, 2h old) - strong on exploit/protocol-decision news specifically
Independent on-chain analyst - produced the single best catch in testing (MANTRA Chain exploit, real forensic tracing, not a repost). Looser window since analysts post less often than wire accounts
Independent researcher - caught the USD1 stablecoin centralization-risk story via own technical analysis, not a wire repost
Well-known independent on-chain investigator, not yet tested live this round but same profile as Rarma_/PhyrexNi - added on pattern, verify on first real run

Specialized exploit/hack alert bot - confirmed hack-only/one-sided in testing (2026-08-21: 'if u follow certik u will find only hack news not goof'), deliberately kept SMALL relative to the wire/analyst lanes so the queue doesn't skew negative
Second hack/exploit alert bot for coverage redundancy - same one-sided caveat as CertiKAlert applies, kept small

The original v1 approach (exact-phrase X search). Demoted to a backstop that only runs every Nth sweep (see QUERY_LANE_EVERY_N_SWEEPS in trend_monitor.js) - proven in testing that exact phrases miss most real headlines' actual wording. Only useful for the rare case a project's own account breaks news before any wire/analyst account has reposted it. Reads its phrase list from queries.json.
